title: FEVER DREAMS
subtitle: ONE MORE TURN
content_note: Psychological horror with non-graphic references to childhood abuse and violated boundaries, pursuit, and death.

intro.speaker: ELI / PATIENT
intro.text: I keep telling everyone I'm doing better. It makes the conversation shorter.

choices.text: You can tell me how it actually is.
choices.response: I go to work. I eat something. I wait until I'm allowed to go back to bed. I don't know what I'm waiting for in between.
My birthday. Twenty-eight. Everyone asked what I wanted. I couldn't think of anything, so I said a cake.

intro.speaker: ELI / PATIENT
intro.text: Then I sleep, and there's the house again. A little witch's cabin. It has my mother's wallpaper. She never lived in a place like that.

choices.text: Who else is in the cabin?
choices.response: A purple figure. Some kind of mechanical performer. It has a smile screwed onto its face. And a woman who takes up the whole window.

choices.text: What happens when you get there?
choices.response: Someone says, 'One more turn.' The music starts. The performer tries very hard. I stay until the song is finished. It never is.

intro.speaker: ELI / PATIENT
intro.text: There are four music boxes. I know that without having counted them. If you let the springs unwind, they play something that happened.

choices.response: The first one. The performer started shaking. The woman noticed me. I woke up before she got through the door.
Everything put back. Everyone smiling. She calls that a good house.

intro.speaker: ELI / PATIENT
intro.text: You can really go in there with me?

choices.text: If you want me to. We can stop here.
choices.response: No. I'd like someone to see it. Just once. Someone who won't tell me I remembered it wrong.

choices.text: Yes. I'll listen to what you find.
choices.response: All right. Don't make the performer dance for you. It thinks that's what people come to see.

intro.speaker: ELI / PATIENT
intro.text: If you find the small door, let me go first. I don't know why. I just know it's mine.

choices.text: All right. Close your eyes when you're ready.
choices.response: There's the music. Can you hear it yet?

choices.text: I'll meet you at the cabin.
choices.response: She's already set a place for you.

rooms.name: THE WITCH'S CABIN
rooms.arrival: A purple mechanical performer jerks through a frantic bow. Its feet stamp out a rhythm that the music has not reached yet.

inspect.rabbit: PERFORMER: Ladies and gentlemen. Ladies and gentlemen. Ladies and— Are you here for the show? I can begin again.
inspect.portrait: THE HOST: Welcome, doctor. We keep a very good house. Nothing unpleasant stays out for long.
inspect.window: The face beyond the glass is too large to belong to anyone standing outside.
inspect.door: A brass plate: EVERY EXIT IS A RETURN. Smaller writing: management accepts no responsibility for missing guests.
inspect.note: HOUSE PROGRAMME, 1938. Smile when spoken to. Put things back. If something breaks, think about what you did.
inspect.music_box: An antique music box. Its key turns backward by itself. Hold it still, then let the spring unwind.

box.title: BOX I / THE GOOD HOUSE
box.before: The performer clutches the little stage. PERFORMER: If it plays the old number, please do not applaud.

choices.response: The key slips through your fingers. The performer's jaw chatters with every note.

choices.text: Tell the performer it doesn't have to perform.
choices.response: PERFORMER: I don't know what to do instead. You release the music-box key.

memory.speaker: ELI / MEMORY
memory.text: I could tell which mood she was in from the way she put her keys down. I knew all the quiet floorboards.

memory.speaker: ELI / MEMORY
memory.text: When my mother hurt me, she said I'd made her do it. Afterward I had to tell her she was a good mother.

memory.speaker: PERFORMER
memory.text: Was that the right answer? Nobody ever told me the right answer.

box.after: The first spring falls silent. Something enormous knocks on the outside of the wall. THE HOST: Put that back.

rooms.name: THE HALLWAY AFTER SCHOOL
rooms.arrival: The cabin door opens onto a corridor of school photographs. Every face has been replaced by the same smile.

inspect.rabbit: The performer is dressed for a school photograph. A bent metal finger keeps adjusting its collar.
inspect.portrait: THE HOST: Children make things up. Such wonderful imaginations.
inspect.window: Through the window: the witch's cabin. Through its window: you.
inspect.door: The last classroom is numbered 2:00. Its handle is warm.
inspect.note: A school report. The only legible sentence: NEEDS TO PARTICIPATE MORE.
inspect.music_box: The second box sits on an empty desk. Someone has scratched NO into the underside of the lid.

box.title: BOX II / AFTER THE BELL
box.before: PERFORMER: There isn't a picture for this one. Don't go looking for one.

choices.response: You let the spring unwind. The photographs turn toward the wall.

choices.text: We don't need to see it.
choices.response: The performer lowers its hands. You release the key. Only the voice comes through.

memory.speaker: ELI / MEMORY
memory.text: Some older children cornered me after school. They touched me after I said no. I couldn't make them stop.

memory.speaker: ELI / MEMORY
memory.text: I tried to tell someone. The first question was why I'd gone with them. I stopped telling the story halfway through.

memory.speaker: DOCTOR
memory.text: You said no. They chose not to listen. That wasn't your fault.

box.after: The music stops. Footsteps continue. In every photograph, the same mouth opens. THE HOST: We don't repeat stories like that.

rooms.name: THE TABLE IS SET
rooms.arrival: A dining table stretches through both walls. Every place card has Eli's name. One of the chairs is breathing.

inspect.rabbit: The performer serves empty plates with a frantic music-hall flourish. Between trips, its shoulders drop for half a second.
inspect.portrait: THE HOST: Look at all the people who need you. Isn't it lovely to be needed?
inspect.window: The face outside is closer. The glass bends around its teeth.
inspect.door: You open the coat cupboard. Inside is another coat cupboard, slightly more disappointed in you.
inspect.note: A stack of birthday cards. Each says: YOU ALWAYS KNOW HOW TO CHEER EVERYONE UP.
inspect.music_box: The third music box is disguised as a place setting. Its spring keeps tightening when nobody touches it.

box.title: BOX III / I'M FINE, THANK YOU
box.before: PERFORMER: I'm very good company. Please write that down.

choices.text: You can put the plates down.
choices.response: The plates remain hanging in the air. You release the spring beneath them.
PERFORMER: I used to know. You let the music box unwind.

memory.speaker: ELI / MEMORY
memory.text: I learned how to sound all right on the telephone. There's a little laugh you can do. People stop asking.

memory.speaker: ELI / MEMORY
memory.text: I cancelled things until the invitations stopped. Then I missed them. Both things were true.

memory.speaker: ELI / MEMORY
memory.text: I still care about them. I just can't keep making a version of myself that doesn't need anything.

box.after: The third melody breaks into a single held note. The door starts to buckle. THE HOST: You're upsetting my guest, doctor.

rooms.name: THE LITTLE STAGE
rooms.arrival: Back in the cabin, faded velvet curtains frame an empty stage. The ceiling is gone. The witch fills the sky. A small door waits under the footlights.

inspect.rabbit: The performer has stopped smiling. The expression underneath is ordinary, and very tired.
inspect.portrait: The portrait is empty. Something has stepped out of the frame.
inspect.window: There is no outside left. Her face covers every possible direction.
inspect.door: A door just large enough for the performer. The name ELI has been scratched into the wood from the other side.
inspect.note: A repair ticket: SMILE MECHANISM FUNCTIONAL. FAULT: KEEPS REQUESTING A BREAK. Beneath it, in smaller letters: REPLACEMENT ATTENDANT REQUIRED.
inspect.music_box: The last spring is almost still. Its rhythm matches your pulse. There is no key to turn it back.

box.title: BOX IV / THE PERSON WHO STAYED
box.before: PERFORMER: I remember the little door now. She said I could leave when somebody else came to watch the house.

choices.response: The room holds its breath. The small door opens a fraction.
The performer nods. You release the spring. Behind you, every other door disappears.

memory.speaker: ELI / MEMORY
memory.text: I used to draw things with too many legs. I used to stay up because I wanted tomorrow to come. I remember wanting things.

memory.speaker: ELI / MEMORY
memory.text: I don't expect one good night to fix me. I just wanted someone to believe I was still in here.

memory.speaker: PERFORMER
memory.text: I think I can fit through. Doctor? Are you coming?

box.after: The performer passes through the little door. It closes before you can follow. A hand settles on your shoulder. THE HOST: Thank you for coming. We never leave the house unattended.

pursuit_lines: THE HOST: We were having such a lovely time.
THE HOST: A guest should know when to be quiet.
THE HOST: You don't live here. You don't get to remember.
THE HOST: I can hear you thinking about the door.

ending.title: SESSION TERMINATED
lines: The fourth music box reaches its final note.
Eli opens his eyes in the consultation room. The chair beside him is empty.
At 02:00, your heart stops. You do not wake up.
Inside the cabin, the witch sets the table for tomorrow.
The performer's stage is empty. A new portrait hangs above it.
ending.last_line: THE HOST: Welcome, doctor. One more turn.

hints: Four springs. Four memories. Let each music box unwind.
Inspect the room before touching the music box.
When the music ends, the witch comes closer. Find the next exit.
The performer moves with the melody. Watch what happens in the silence.
Eli's small door is not an exit for everyone.
